The '''Melus system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] that was located in the [[Nicandra sector/Legends|Nicandra sector]], within the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]<ref name="EAOC" /> and [[New Territories/Legends|New Territories]] regions of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="New Territories" /> The system was the namesake of the [[Melusi Uprising]], a conflict which the [[Judicial Forces/Legends|Judicial Forces]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] ended around [[900 BBY/Legends|900 BBY]].<ref name="TEGtW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Melus system was established in the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', which placed the system in grid square L-7.<ref name="EAOC" />
